raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions sums raw amount without regard to currency, so the 85 EUR rows are treated as USD in the gold totals. raw_fx_rates has a rate_to_usd for EUR (1.25) dated before all the transactions, so amounts can be converted in silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON t.currency = f.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
